imageryNote: Satellite crops are Copernicus Sentinel-2 L2A, 10 m multispectral pixels, rendered from the Microsoft Planetary Computer mirror of the Copernicus archive. Each frame is labeled with the scene acquisition time in the product metadata. Cloud cover is the scene-level figure, not a measurement inside the crop. Downloading pixels from the Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem itself needs CDSE credentials; the scheduled job searches CDSE and falls back to Planetary Computer for the image. Frames are not a construction survey.

sites.name: Mäntsälä
sites.relationship: Owned. Finnish registry name Nebius DC Oy, formerly Global DC Oy and Yandex Oy.
sites.status: Serving. Cloud region eu-north1 is Finland.
sites.capacity: Company target of about 75 MW contracted power for the expansion, by the end of 2025 or early 2026. Megawatts in service were not restated in the 2026 letters reviewed.
sites.dates: Expansion described October 31, 2024 and again August 7, 2025. A second Mäntsälä site is named for 2027 deployment and has no separate footprint here.

pin.precision: Facility. Address from the Finnish Business Information System. Image window is centered on the OpenStreetMap coordinate published for that address.

sites.notes: Sentinel-2 pixels are 10 m. The crops are about 2 km across. Roofs and new pads are visible; this is not a survey and not a measurement of megawatts.

sites.name: Second Mäntsälä site
sites.relationship: Owned site named for future deployment. No separate address published in the sources reviewed.
sites.status: Named for 2027. Not a separate live cloud region.
sites.dates: Q3 2026 shareholder letter: expected to deploy capacity in 2027, with Lappeenranta, Missouri, and Alabama.
sites.notes: Not pinned. A second marker on the town would invent a footprint.

sites.name: Lappeenranta
sites.relationship: Owned site named for 2027 deployment.
sites.status: Named, not in the live regions list retrieved November 23, 2026.
sites.capacity: Not disclosed for this name. On May 13, 2026 the company announced a new owned Finland location of 310 MW at full deployment and did not name the municipality in that paragraph. These two statements are not tied together here.
sites.dates: Named November 12, 2026 for a 2027 deployment.

pin.precision: City centroid of Lappeenranta, not a facility.

sites.notes: No satellite image. A city image would not be the site.

sites.name: Finland 310 MW factory
sites.relationship: Owned.
sites.status: Announced May 13, 2026.
sites.dates: Announced in the Q1 2026 shareholder letter. In-service date not stated there.
sites.notes: Kept separate from Lappeenranta and the second Mäntsälä site because the May letter did not name the city.

sites.name: Keflavík
sites.relationship: Colocation with Verne.
sites.status: Cloud region eu-north2 is Iceland and lists compute as available.
sites.dates: March 5, 2025 post: expected fully operational by the end of March 2025. Completion of that date was not confirmed in a later filing reviewed.

pin.precision: Town of Keflavík. The Verne campus footprint was not taken from a Nebius filing.

sites.notes: No satellite image, because the pin is the town, not the hall.

sites.name: France
sites.place: Paris cluster announced; regions eu-west1 and eu-west2 are both France
sites.relationship: Colocation, as described in 2025 letters.
sites.status: Serving. Both France region codes list compute.
sites.capacity: Not disclosed in the primary sources reviewed. A 5 MW figure appears in secondary write-ups and is not used.
sites.dates: GPU cluster in Paris announced around September 2024, in the Q3 2024 release, as one of the first in Europe with NVIDIA H200 GPUs.

pin.precision: Paris city centroid. The colocation address was not published in the sources reviewed. Two region codes are not treated as two proven campuses.

sites.name: Kansas City
sites.relationship: Colocation.
sites.status: Serving. Region us-central1 is Kansas City.
sites.capacity: Not disclosed in megawatts in the company posts and letters reviewed.
sites.dates: First phase expected in March 2025. The Q2 2025 letter says the site launched in April 2025, with more capacity in early July. The March 5, 2025 post said a second phase was expected by the end of Q2 2025.

pin.precision: City centroid, not the colocation hall.

sites.notes: This is separate from the Independence, Missouri factory.

sites.name: New Jersey
sites.place: Vinefield, New Jersey, as named by the company
sites.relationship: Build with DataOne. The Q2 2025 letter calls it a new facility.
sites.status: Partial delivery. The November 12, 2026 letter says remaining tranches moved, with more than half of the Microsoft-contracted capacity expected by year-end 2026 and the rest in Q2 2027.
sites.capacity: Expandable up to 300 MW (March 5, 2025). As of August 7, 2025, 200 MW was contracted and in construction, of which 100 MW was planned for 2025.
sites.dates: See the guidance item. Instances were planned for fall 2025.
sites.notes: Not pinned. The company spelling is Vinefield. A street address was not in the sources reviewed, and Vineland is a different name this site does not assume.

sites.name: United Kingdom

sites.status: Serving. uk-south1 and uk-south2 both list compute.
sites.dates: Announced in the Q2 2025 letter for later in 2025. NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra in the UK was expected during Q4 2025. The Q4 2025 letter counts the UK among new sites.
sites.notes: Two region codes are listed. They are not mapped as two cities.
